Branch ordering: `typeof d === 'string'` matches FastAPI's default 404 body `{"detail":"Not Found"}` first, so the toast displays 'Not Found' instead of the actionable message.
failed.evidence: Simulated 404 via page.route override on /api/auth/password-reset/request returning {"detail":"Not Found"}. Observed sonner toast text = 'Not Found'. Screenshot: .screenshots/reset_404_toast.png

action_items: In /app/frontend/src/pages/ResetPassword.jsx requestToken catch block, reorder branches so `s === 404` is checked BEFORE `typeof d === 'string'` (or additionally treat d === 'Not Found' as 404). Otherwise the newly added user-facing message is unreachable and the original user complaint ('request code failed as 404') is not actually rectified.
